# store

```go
import "github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/internal/store"
```

Package store defines the persistence contract. Every backend must pass storetest.Run.

Semantics every backend guarantees:

- Secrets are partitioned by Region. ARN is globally unique. Name is unique within a region among all secrets the store holds \(including ones scheduled for deletion: the service layer decides what a deleted secret means; only DeleteSecret frees the name\).
- Returned secrets are deep copies; mutating them never changes stored state.
- UpdateSecret is atomic: fn runs on a copy while no other write to that secret can interleave; if fn returns an error nothing is stored and that error is returned unchanged. fn must not change ARN, Name or Region \(ErrImmutable\).
- ListSecrets returns every secret in the region ordered by CreatedDate ascending, ties broken by ARN ascending.

<a name="MetaLister"></a>
## type [MetaLister](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/store/store.go#L51-L53>)

MetaLister is an optional Store extension for low\-memory listing. ListSecretsMeta returns the same secrets, in the same order, as ListSecrets, but every Version has SecretString and SecretBinary nil \(ids, stages, dates and KMS ids kept\), so listing never copies secret values. Use store.ListMeta, which falls back to ListSecrets for stores without it.

```go
type MetaLister interface {
    ListSecretsMeta(ctx context.Context, region string) ([]*model.Secret, error)
}
```

<a name="Store"></a>
## type [Store](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/store/store.go#L29-L45>)



```go
type Store interface {
    // CreateSecret stores a new secret. ErrExists if Region+Name or ARN is taken.
    CreateSecret(ctx context.Context, s *model.Secret) error
    // GetSecretByARN returns the secret with that exact ARN in region, or ErrNotFound.
    GetSecretByARN(ctx context.Context, region, arn string) (*model.Secret, error)
    // GetSecretByName returns the secret named name in region, or ErrNotFound.
    GetSecretByName(ctx context.Context, region, name string) (*model.Secret, error)
    // ListSecrets returns all secrets in region (see ordering above).
    ListSecrets(ctx context.Context, region string) ([]*model.Secret, error)
    // ListRegions returns every region that holds at least one secret, sorted.
    ListRegions(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error)
    // UpdateSecret atomically applies fn and returns the stored result.
    UpdateSecret(ctx context.Context, region, arn string, fn func(*model.Secret) error) (*model.Secret, error)
    // DeleteSecret permanently removes a secret (and frees its name). ErrNotFound if absent.
    DeleteSecret(ctx context.Context, region, arn string) error
    Close() error
}
```
